verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Full Power Energy Wave — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Full Power Energy Wave as a Ki Blast Ultimate with a long-range beam, 18-hit characteristic, and 300 Ki cost.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current DBXV2 reference material lists the Skill Shop after completion of the God of Destruction's Anger story segment as the acquisition route. Dragon Ball reference material independently describes Skill Shop acquisition after the Battle of Gods portion of the main story.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes Skill Shop/story-gated acquisition rather than a PQ reward condition, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Current reference material reports damage and hit-count information, but exact damage values are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.
